title: Burgers · inspectable research attempt
text:
Worked example authored for this studio, not an imported research paper.
Consider the inviscid Burgers equation u_t + u*u_x = 0.
Assume a smooth classical solution while following a characteristic dx/dt = u.
Set m = u_x along that characteristic. Differentiating the PDE yields dm/dt = -m**2.
For m(0) = -1, the reduced equation gives m(t) = -1/(1-t) while t < 1.
This reduced calculation does not solve the Navier-Stokes global regularity problem.
Open question: which assumptions allow a related mechanism in a different PDE?

model.name: Burgers characteristic gradient
assumptions: A smooth inviscid Burgers solution exists up to the times considered.
m follows a characteristic; this is not the full PDE simulation.
